card.title: Orders from the Shadows
card.instruction: Hide that you set the problem in motion while quietly directing how everyone responds.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The crates went to Leeds. Send the driver to me; I'll sort it quietly.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your email says Leeds. Shall I forward it to the manager?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Forward my corrected address instead. She needs the destination, not the correspondence.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She wants a timeline before approving another van.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Start with when we discovered the error. I'll arrange the van while you write.

mechanism: A directs recovery of misrouted crates while excluding the email and early timeline that reveal A caused it.
confusable: Unlike generally minimizing trouble, A must control the response to suppress their own initiating action.
comparison: D61-a substitutes corrected address and discovery-time chronology; D61-b substitutes individual restoration to avoid an automated culprit email.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
